subject: Re: MERF kickoff — LRB scope decision
body:
Team,

Decisions locked with Nadia for the 07-10 Launch Review Board:

1) Demo is desktop-first; the mobile profile ships as a clearly-labeled "preview" tier exactly per Yara's option (b). The 0.8 PSNR / 24 fps mobile numbers go in the pre-read so nobody is surprised.
2) The June sweep results carry the story: all 9 scenes retrained and baked in our reservation week, bake-vs-train delta held under 0.05 PSNR at final settings — the "lossless baking" claim survives contact with production settings, which is the headline.
3) Scope cut: partner-scene ingestion tooling (custom capture -> MERF) moves to next window; LRB sees mipnerf360 scenes plus our two office captures only.

Also flagging: Leilani's embed API drew interest from two partner teams already. Good problem.

Zofia
